title: Vietnamese Odyssey Group Tour
alt: Cruise boat anchored among the karsts of Halong Bay at dusk
transport: Two domestic flights, an overnight cruise and guided tours

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel with a spa, a few streets from the old quarter

activities.name: Hanoi city tour
activities.description: The Ho Chi Minh mausoleum and the one pillar pagoda, the Temple of Literature and the lanes of the old quarter with a guide.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: Two nights in the capital with a guided day of the mausoleum, the pagoda and the old quarter.

stops.name: Halong Bay
stops.accom: 1 night · All meals · Cabin with a window · 4★ · Four star cruise boat moored among the limestone islands overnight

activities.name: Overnight stay on the bay
activities.description: Out among the limestone islands by boat, with lunch and dinner served on deck and a night moored in a quiet bay.

program.name: Halong Bay
program.description: A night aboard a four star cruise boat on the bay, with all meals included.

stops.name: Da Nang
stops.subtitle: Da Nang and Ba Na Hills
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel between the river and My Khe beach

activities.name: Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge
activities.match: Ba Na Hills and Golden Bridge Day Tour
activities.description: The long cable car up to Ba Na, the Golden Bridge held up by two stone hands, and the French village and gardens at the top.

program.name: Da Nang
program.description: Off the water and south by air for two nights near the beach, with a full day up at Ba Na.

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stops.subtitle: Hoi An, Saigon and Cu Chi
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Hotel beside the park in District 1, near the Ben Thanh market

activities.name: Hoi An city tour
activities.description: The old trading town on foot, the Japanese covered bridge, the assembly halls and the merchant houses before the flight south.

activities.name: Saigon city tour with the Cu Chi tunnels
activities.match: Half Day Ho Chi Minh City Tour with Cu Chi Tunnel
activities.description: The Reunification Palace, the cathedral and the war remnants museum, then north west to the tunnel network at Cu Chi.

program.name: Ho Chi Minh City
program.description: A morning in Hoi An, the flight south, then the city and the Cu Chi tunnels.

day_titles.6: Hoi An and on to Saigon

Check in and meet the rest of the group

The Temple of Literature, the old university
The old quarter lanes in the afternoon
3: Breakfast and check out, then east towards the coast

Lunch and dinner served on deck
A night moored among the limestone islands

Back to the pier and on to Hanoi airport
Check in between the river and the beach

The Golden Bridge held up by two stone hands

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: The same route as our shorter group tour with a night on the bay added, which is the one thing worth the extra day.
expert.tip: The Majestic is a four star boat, so take the sun deck in the evening. The bay goes quiet once the day boats leave.

summary: Eight days north to south with a small group: two nights in Hanoi with a guided city day, a night aboard a four star cruise boat on Halong Bay, two in Da Nang with Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge, a morning in Hoi An, then two in Saigon with the city and the Cu Chi tunnels.
included: Included: 7 nights with daily breakfast and all meals on the cruise boat; two domestic flights; all coach travel and transfers; a guided Hanoi city tour; an overnight cruise in Halong Bay; a full day up at Ba Na with the Golden Bridge; a Hoi An city tour; a half day Saigon city tour with the Cu Chi tunnels.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
